recomputed: All 40 entries in SOURCES.tsv matched their byte counts and SHA-256 digests (17,089,958 bytes total). I parsed the JSON and XML responses, checked the HTML contents, decoded both Figure 1 JPEGs, read the three-page preprint PDF and verified the publisher DOCX ZIP entries and both TIFFs. The two supplements cover CX30 staining and fat/lean mass. The manuscript lists one supplemental PDF. Independent replay in refute/recheck.py matched 33 GSM file declarations to 33 gzip members in the GEO tar and read all rows. Every member has 55,471 distinct Ensembl gene identifiers, four STAR summary identifiers and three nonnegative integer count columns. SOFT gives control 9M/8F and exposed 7M/9F. OBFH14 and OBFH5 are recorded male, OBMH20 and OBMH4 female. Removing exposed male GSM7163652 (OBFH14) reproduces every registered GSM assignment across the six litters. Controls contribute 3/3/3 offspring and exposed litters 1/2/3. The registered edgeR-QL groupcase coefficient is prenatal benzene relative to filtered air in P21 male whole hypothalamus. The model tested 22,319 rows including 523 unmapped. The published table has 21,796 rows and 21,796 distinct symbols, SHA-256 2af297d5e351ea238e9b0286eceee057643b6a661e9edc80d08af8e1174d22c0, which matches provenance. PRJNA954440 has 33 distinct ENA read runs, whose experiments match the 33 GEO records, and zero ENA analysis rows. The manuscript and preprint specify a total-count floor of 20, sex-stratified DESeq2/apeglm, BH-adjusted P < 0.1 and 66 reported male DEGs. Figure 1B provides selected directions (Ucp2 higher, Ebf2 lower in exposed males) without documenting litter weighting or providing shrunken coefficients, P values or FDR. I re-fetched the GEO SOFT, ENA analysis report and publisher DOCX and matched their hashes. The Sadagurski lab publication page links the paper, PubMed and Semantic Scholar. The related figshare candidate concerns a different study with fetal or P17 endpoints. The Wayne State dissertation landing page supplies an abstract. Its download returned HTTP 403, so the full dissertation remains unexamined. No source inspected supplied an eligible litter-level author effect. No paired-gene metrics, subset, or threshold for agreement were used. The current dataset has manual and verification records and no entry in the other three ledgers. All proposed enum values, evidence-link kinds and the empty sign-off list occur in the ledgers.
problems: Individual indexing and exclusion of one offspring are documented. Neither source gives the DE design formula or says whether siblings were treated as independent. The original manual summary treated a different replicate unit as established. The corrected wording identifies the missing model evidence and describes the results as sex-stratified.

The original reopening criterion required identical within-litter count sums. A documented author analysis of the same exposure effect with compatible litter handling could also qualify, including within a selected-gene scope.

SOURCES.tsv describes publisher.html as an article and supplement inventory. Its 2,740 bytes are an Elsevier Linking Hub redirect. The preprint API record also gives the published field as NA and cannot establish the journal publication relation on its own. The directly inspected JATS, figure and supplement files support the closure.
